scenarios: Real create, Cinder purchase and confirmed street-engine installation; selected owned ID enters the facility with the exact accepted saved build
Fresh keyboard throttle and steering move the actual owned chassis through normal animation frames; pause freezes accepted ticks
Held key → blur → off-window release pauses and clears driving; resume stays neutral until a fresh key press
Actual WebGL context loss/restoration preserves accepted owned state, pauses physics and requires fresh controls
Production stock/current/proposed reference comparisons run all four physical benchmarks; real fitted engine and sandbox short gearbox have distinct source-bound accepted recipes
A normal-frame reference acceleration completes and native export records its original saved build, source, commands and accepted terminal result
All six freely admitted catalogue stock models spawn their actual finite physical chassis and respond to live throttle without creating owned cars
Return and reload preserve the exact serialized Vault envelope, credits, owned identity and fitted engine after every facility operation
